atomicity.reason: One obligation: disconnect within 100 ms after the fault report.

feasibility.reason: Contactor opening within 100 ms is common practice.

parent_fit.reason: Disconnecting the HV battery on an isolation fault protects the driver from electric shock (US_HV_SAFETY).

unambiguity.reason: The start point 'reports' (fault set in the BMS vs. received by the vehicle) and whether 'disconnect' means both HV poles open are not pinned down.
unambiguity.suggestion: Define the time reference (e.g. reception of the isolation-fault signal on the vehicle bus) and 'disconnect' (both main contactors open).

verifiability.reason: Measurable: time from the BMS isolation-fault report to contactors open <= 100 ms.
